title: Shabbir hai safar may
body:
shabbir hai safar may aur saath zahra saani
dohrayi hasbuna ki ummat ne phir kahani
<<DIVIDER>>
kaabe ke maalikon ke ehraam khol daale
aayat e innama ki kuch bhi khadar na jaani
shabbir hai safar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
nau khez khoon e akbar hai deen ki ragon may
khaayam hai jis ka sadqa islam ki jawani
shabbir hai safar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
mukhtaar unke bacche hai aab aab karte
farte haya se darya hota hai pani pani
shabbir hai safar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran tazkira hai aale nabi ke ghar ka
khoon e rag e shaheedan tafseer hai purani
shabbir hai safar may...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ilteja raza ki pesh e safeer e akbar
aankhon se khoon ban kar tapke teri kahani
shabbir hai safar may...
author: Raza
